title: 'Add launcher...' window could appear on left click on widget icon if there aren't any launchers yet
line: Clicking an empty Quicklaunch widget now opens the Add Launcher dialog.
explanation: When Quicklaunch has no launchers it shows a placeholder icon with a tooltip saying to add launchers by drag and drop or the context menu. The placeholder had no click handler, so a left click did nothing and users had to discover the right-click Add Launcher action. The change adds a MouseArea on the placeholder that calls the same addLauncher() as the context menu action; it is hidden together with the placeholder once a launcher exists.

commits.message:
applets/quicklaunch: open Add Launcher dialog when clicking empty widget

An empty Quicklaunch widget only showed a placeholder icon with a hint
tooltip, and clicking it did nothing. Now a left click on the icon opens
the same Add Launcher dialog as the context menu action does.

BUG: 384007

patches.diff:
From f829a77114dd9ce3f8e936b0620b6624f838f4a1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 22:08:18 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/quicklaunch: open Add Launcher dialog when clicking
 empty widget

An empty Quicklaunch widget only showed a placeholder icon with a hint
tooltip, and clicking it did nothing. Now a left click on the icon opens
the same Add Launcher dialog as the context menu action does.

BUG: 384007
---
 applets/quicklaunch/main.qml | 5 +++++
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/quicklaunch/main.qml b/applets/quicklaunch/main.qml
index 012b52556..93a677864 100644
--- a/applets/quicklaunch/main.qml
+++ b/applets/quicklaunch/main.qml
@@ -112,6 +112,11 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                     mainText: i18nc("@info:tooltip widget title", "Quicklaunch")
                     subText: i18nc("@info:tooltip widget subtitle", "Add launchers by Drag and Drop or by using the context menu.")
                     location: Plasmoid.location
+
+                    MouseArea {
+                        anchors.fill: parent
+                        onClicked: logic.addLauncher()
+                    }
                 }
             }
         }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: left-clicking the empty Quicklaunch in the panel only shows the hint tooltip
Fix: the same click opens the Choose Application (Add Launcher) dialog

review.text: Simple, clean addition in quicklaunch/main.qml: placing a left-click MouseArea inside defaultIcon's ToolTipArea opens the existing Add Launcher dialog on click while preserving the hover tooltip, right-click context menu, and drag-and-drop, and disappears automatically once a launcher is added. Minor non-blocking niceties could be gating on !Plasmoid.immutable and adding keyboard/Accessible handling like arrowMouseArea below it.

reviews.text: Simple, clean addition in quicklaunch/main.qml: placing a left-click MouseArea inside defaultIcon's ToolTipArea opens the existing Add Launcher dialog on click while preserving the hover tooltip, right-click context menu, and drag-and-drop, and disappears automatically once a launcher is added. Minor non-blocking niceties could be gating on !Plasmoid.immutable and adding keyboard/Accessible handling like arrowMouseArea below it.

Does exactly what the wish asks: a left click on the empty Quicklaunch placeholder opens the same Add Launcher dialog as the context-menu action, through the existing logic.addLauncher(). The MouseArea lives inside the placeholder icon, which is only visible when there are no launchers, and it only accepts the left button, so right-click still reaches the context menu and the handler goes away once a launcher exists. It's a 5-line change in the right file, the screenshot shows the dialog opening, and the commit message matches. Optional polish: the tooltip could mention clicking, and the placeholder has no keyboard or accessible activation, but neither is needed to close the bug.
